summary: newcleo plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that William D. Magwood, IV, former U.S. NRC Commissioner and DOE nuclear chief, is anticipated to join its Board as Vice-Chairman effective January 1, 2027, after stepping down from the OECD NEA. The appointment follows the recent naming of Jeffrey Lyash as Chairman. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated; this is an ordinary board-appointment disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation, though board consolidation may interest governance watchers.
